leads.name: Latitude Legal — Corporate Counsel, JV/Governance & M&A (Engagement, Remote)
leads.industry: Flexible legal staffing — Chambers-ranked ALSP placing former in-house and AmLaw counsel into contract engagements. This posting routes to a regulated-industries client (energy or adjacent) needing entity formation, restructuring, JV structuring, and M&A due-diligence/transaction support.
leads.compensationText: Annualized $225,000–$280,000+ on a full-time-equivalent basis (Latitude W-2 contract; benefits & PLI included at 20+ hrs/wk)
leads.notes: Combined 75 / Grade B+. Strongest Latitude posting of the week for Katie's profile — JV / governance / M&A is squarely her corporate wheelhouse, and the $225–280k annualized band is the highest comp in any 5/29 lead. Regulated-industries context (likely energy) adds a small specialty stretch but isn't disqualifying — the structuring + diligence muscle transfers directly from fund/LP work. The DC / Charlotte / Columbia geographic preference appears to be 'preferred,' not 'required,' on the engagement; confirm during intake. Pitch: corporate M&A + JV structuring + governance build, immediate availability, AmLaw-pedigree fund-side reference points.

leads.name: Fractionus (EdTech SaaS) — Fractional General Counsel, K-12 Commercial Contracts (Remote, $250–350/hr)
leads.industry: Growth-stage EdTech SaaS — building commercial legal layer for K-12 sales. Role focuses on standardizing contracts, managing the CLM system, and advising on EdTech regulations (FERPA, student data privacy, district approval flows).
leads.location: Remote (New York posting; remote candidates considered)
leads.compensationText: $250–350/hr; explicit path to FTE as the company scales
leads.employmentTypeRaw: Fractional / part-time engagement (1099 or 1099-equivalent); explicit FTE conversion path
leads.notes: Combined 75 / Grade B. The published $250–350/hr band is unusually transparent and sits above market median for fractional GC engagements — that alone makes the posting worth pursuing even though the K-12 / EdTech specialty is a stretch for Katie's fund/corporate profile. The work itself is commercial-contract standardization + CLM management + sales-paper review, which transfers cleanly. Pitch angle: senior commercial-contracts depth + CLM build experience + ability to architect approval flows. Be honest about FERPA / district-approval depth being on-ramping, not pre-built. The 7+ years SaaS requirement is genuine, so frame Katie's SaaS-vendor and software-licensing exposure from prior corporate work.

leads.name: Radian Capital — General Counsel (Remote; Fund, Firm, and Portfolio Matters)
leads.industry: Growth equity firm — investing in B2B software and tech-enabled services. GC role works directly with Co-Founders across legal matters for the Fund, the Firm (management company), and Portfolio companies.
leads.compensationText: Not stated; market range for growth-equity GC is $250–450k base + carry (FTE); interim-coverage pitch would target $300–450/hr
leads.employmentTypeRaw: Full-time (FTE) — pitched here as interim-coverage entry point
leads.notes: Combined 70 / Grade B. This is the most ICP-aligned posting of the week even though it's a full-time hire, not an engagement model. Radian Capital is a B2B-software-focused growth equity firm — exactly the lower-middle-market buyer Katie targets. The role spans Fund, Firm, and Portfolio work, which mirrors her pitch deck. Pitch angle: offer interim GC coverage during the permanent search (3–6 months), with explicit option to convert to FTE if mutual fit. This works because (a) search timelines for fund-side GC roles are typically 4–6 months, (b) deal flow doesn't pause for hiring, and (c) interim coverage gives the firm a working interview. Send a 1-page interim-coverage proposal alongside the standard application.

leads.name: Affirm Partners — General Counsel, Private Equity Fund (Interim Coverage Pitch)
leads.industry: Private equity fund — emerging-manager investing in lower-middle-market opportunities. GC role covers fund formation, LP/GP-side fund documents, portfolio company governance, and regulatory compliance.
leads.compensationText: Not stated; PE-fund GC market range is $300–500k base + carry (FTE); interim-coverage pitch would target $350–500/hr
leads.employmentTypeRaw: Full-time (FTE) — pitched here as interim-coverage entry point
leads.notes: Combined 55 / Grade C (borderline pass). Included because the buyer profile — an emerging-manager PE fund — is exactly Katie's strongest ICP angle, even though the posting is full-time and NY-based. Emerging managers are also more likely than established firms to consider an interim/fractional GC coverage arrangement because (a) Fund I/II economics don't always justify a FTE GC at the front end, and (b) they need fund-formation and LP-document depth right when comp budget is tightest. Pitch angle: 'I can cover your GC scope on an interim basis at a fractional commitment while you decide whether the GC role is FTE-justified at current AUM.' Confirm NY hybrid requirement before investing intake time. If hybrid is mandatory and Katie isn't NYC-flexible right now, deprioritize and move to the Radian Capital pitch first.
